notes.title: Exciting News about the game!
notes.notes:
I got exciting news (atleast for me): The store page for the FULL GAME is now live!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3277640/BugSplash_TD__Debugged/

Whats the difference to the free version?

[b]The full game is scheduled to include:[/b]
- a tutorial
- 24 different towers
- more maps
- challenges (which will probably translate to Steam Achievements later on)
- idle maps to farm for upgrades

and of course support for future user ideas & feature requests

Thats it for today
Have a nice week!

notes.title: Dev Blog #2: Preparing for the future
notes.notes:
Hey there,
it has been a while but now I am back to share some news, or rather, a new feature: The LOADOUT PAGE!
This page will allow the player to set up their own custom set of towers.

Here is a screenshot of the current page (work in progress...):
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107637/cb52eb56624549ee19fe9d81329fff382cce15d9.png[/img]

Naturally there are no more than the 6 basic towers at the moment (or are there???)
The page also shows all details about a tower by hovering it, which is not visible in the current screenshot.
Thats it for today

[b]PS:[/b] If you havent reviewed the game yet, please consider doing so. Every review helps, especially the first ten ones. Of course non formal feedback via Steam is welcome aswell

notes.title: Dev Blog #1: Attempting to introduce the player to the game mechanics
notes.notes:
First of all: Thanks for playing everyone!

Second of all: Here is the first Developer Blog I have ever done

[b]The topic for today: My thoughts when designing the currently available maps.[/b]
Map design was planned to slowly introduce the player to the game mechanics. Which means every map is supposed to teach something new to the player or to expand on existing knowledge:

Map 1 is supposed to introduce the different damage elements and the towers to the player.
Map 2 is supposed to introduce the special tower slots.
Map 3 is supposed to introduce how the special effect knockback can work with terrain.
Map 4 introduces the non-buildable projectile speed up support tower.
Map 5 is supposed to test everything the player has learned on previous maps.

Thats about it for today.
I will try to keep up with new Dev Blogs while further developing the game, so stay tuned.
Every feedback is welcome!

Also: There is a small update scheduled for next week
